Cold June dawn timing and every mist/dew/frost object remain English; boundary and the complete ordered property/site-object list remain English. The localized Mark prefixes retain the action while leaving uncertain observation/geometric terms exact. No safety condition, timing, direction, object, or ownership scope is added or removed.

tshivendaSlide18Body2.sourceEnglish: These plants can grow in disturbed places, but their presence alone does not show whether the soil is compacted. Check the soil before deciding what the patch means for your design.
tshivendaSlide18Body2.currentPairedTarget: Zwino zwimela zwi nga mela fhethu ho vhilinganywaho (disturbed places), fhedzi u vha hone hazwo fhedzi a zwi sumbedzi arali mavu o tsitsikana (compacted). Check the soil before deciding what the patch means for your design.
tshivendaSlide18Body2.finding: Zwino is used as “now” in other current Tshivenda learner prose (for example, “Zwino humbulani…” / “Now remember…”), so “Zwino zwimela” risks adding a temporal Now where the source says These plants.
